explanation: The cumene process is the dominant industrial phenol synthesis (~95% worldwide). Acid-catalyzed rearrangement of cumene hydroperoxide (Ph-C(CH₃)₂-OOH) cleaves to phenol + acetone. Both are valuable products — the economics only work because acetone is co-produced.
